QuestInfo.name: [Sleepywood] Diary of an Adventurer
QuestInfo.0: You returned the Key to the Forgotten Shrine to Gwin. He seems like he has more to say.
QuestInfo.1: Gwin asked you to take his diary to Ilji as a token of gratitude.
QuestInfo.2: You gave Gwin's Travel Stories to Ilji. It seemed to really get him excited.

0.0: Are you heading back to Sleepywood?
0.1: Could you take this to #bIlji#k for me? It's my diary. I think a boy like that could use a little direction and I'd like to think my words will help.

yes.0: It's about time I got going. Maybe we'll see each other again one day. Thanks for taking that diary to Ilji.

no.0: I'm doing okay now. Thanks again for saving my hide.

1.0: What happened to that injured guy? Is he okay?

yes.0: Whoa, the diary of a great warrior! I'm gonna read the whole thing and get super strong!

npc.0: You haven't gone back to Sleepywood yet? Please be sure to take my diary to Ilji.

item.0: Huh? I thought you were gonna give me something. No fair teasing!

lost.0: You must be ready to get outta here. You almost forgot to take the diary! Please, take this to Ilji.
